paragraphs.text: The Most Dangerous Gamer is a human gamer guest who spends time at Myra the Magnificent's Intergalactic Astrotorium of Fun .

His name is self-explanatory; he is the deadliest gamer in the galaxy. He has mastered every skill one would need for carnival games: there is no one better at sharpshooting tiny little targets with softballs from far away; he can knock over the most milk bottles in the entire quadrant; he hits the 10,000 every time on skeeball. He has been to every theme park in the universe, and the Astrotorium is his favorite. He is in it all for the prizes, and will not stop until he has won them all.

Myra considers him to be the fifth plague of the park, and curses his name daily. His picture is plastered all over the park on wanted posters, and thus he has to wear his mask to continue his prize-winning endeavors. He also generally sneaks into the park, avoiding both unwanted attention and needing to pay.
When not gaming, he retreats to his asteroid lair full of prizes. The lair is filled with stuffed animals, some of which he has mounted.
